d.subject: Confirmed selector defect: equal-resolution standard preference is not enacted
d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
d.finding: choose() computes best with resolution then !isStandard, but replaces current only when best.resolution < current.resolution. If an equal-resolution vendor is current and an equal-resolution standard candidate later emits, best=standard yet current remains vendor and the standard event is rejected.
d.en: Confirmed a second bug in the same public-sensor selector: equal-resolution standard-over-vendor preference is calculated but cannot trigger a switch because the switch predicate compares only resolution.
